2. By means of the present
application, the applicants seek grant of
anticipatory bail in connection with
FIR/Case Crime No. 40 of 2026,
registered at Police Station Doiwala,
District Dehradun, for the offence
punishable under Section 80(2) of the
Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
3. A Coordinate Bench of this Court,
vide order dated 20.03.2026, granted
interim anticipatory bail to the
applicants. In compliance with the
conditions stipulated therein, the
applicants have duly cooperated with the
investigation as and when called upon
by the Investigating Officer.
4. It has been brought to the notice of
this Court that the investigation has
since been concluded and the charge-sheet has already been submitted before
the competent Court.
Learned counsel for the applicants
submits that pursuant to the interim
protection granted by this Court, the
applicants have cooperated throughout

UKHC010039782026
2026:UHC:7285
the investigation and have not misused
the liberty granted to them. It is further
submitted that the investigation has
culminated in the submission of the
charge-sheet and, therefore, no custodial
interrogation of the applicants is
required at this stage.
5. Per contra, learned counsel for the
State opposes the anticipatory bail
application. However, he does not
dispute that the applicants have
cooperated during the course of
investigation and that the charge-sheet
has already been filed before the
competent Court.
6. Having heard learned counsel for
the parties, perused the material
available on record, and considering the
facts and circumstances of the case, this
Court finds that the applicants have
remained protected by virtue of the
interim order dated 20.03.2026 and have
duly complied with the conditions
incorporated therein by extending full
cooperation during the course of the
investigation. The investigation has
culminated in the submission of the
charge-sheet before the competent
Court. No material has been placed
before this Court to indicate that the
applicants have either misused the
liberty granted to them or failed to
cooperate with the investigating agency.
It is also not the case of the prosecution
that the custodial interrogation of the
applicants is required at this stage.
7. Having regard to the nature of the
allegations, the stage of the proceedings,
the conduct of the applicants during the
period of interim protection, and the
overall facts and circumstances of the
case, and without expressing any
opinion on the merits of the prosecution
case, this Court is of the considered
opinion that the applicants have made

UKHC010039782026
2026:UHC:7285
out a fit case for confirmation of the
interim anticipatory bail granted vide
order dated 20.03.2026.
8. Consequently, the interim
anticipatory bail granted to the
applicants vide order dated 20.03.2026
is hereby confirmed and made absolute.
The applicants shall remain on
anticipatory bail on the same terms and
conditions as contained in the aforesaid
order and shall continue to cooperate
with the trial proceedings. It shall also
be open to the learned Trial Court to
impose such further conditions, if
considered necessary, in accordance
with law.
9. Accordingly, the present
Anticipatory Bail Application stands
allowed.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
